notes: Drafting uses gpt-6.1-sol/high; read-only review, separate revision and independent re-review use gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh. Re-review returns to the review pool in a new context/session after any revision.
The controller uses actual model-selectable Codex CLI executions or child-agent calls. This JSON is a policy, not a model invocation.
Freeze this policy and the rule version/hash in each batch. Do not silently apply later global changes to an active batch.
Dispatch logs are controller-captured records; field validation cannot independently attest that a model executed.
Controller defer events may record failures or missing input, but must never claim a successful model dispatch or review.
New batches use parallel_batch.py. Existing serial batches retain their frozen policy and batch_tool.py.

Capacity is verified for the selected CLI or collaboration transport and account/resource limits, excluding unrelated workers; never infer it from target_workers or equate app slots with CLI capacity.

Separate project and attempt directories; one active stage per project. Hard pool limits are 16 draft, 8 review and 8 revise; no cross-pool borrowing beyond those limits. Initial review and independent re-review share the review limit. For a 64GB machine this is the recommended maximum of 32 simultaneous CLI tasks; actual total capacity must be supplied explicitly and may be lower than 32.

Deliver each independently accepted final to its original case folder immediately. Freeze the parent of each original primary_source and its directory identity at init; the exact filename is the complete case folder basename plus .docx. Preserve every original proposal and attachment.

Only the controller publishes accepted current-SHA DOCX files to frozen original case folders. Workers write attempt directories only. Keep receipts and pending notes in the batch work directory; reject duplicate target paths and every unowned existing target without overwriting, renaming or adding a suffix.

New batches follow efficiency.md: verified case-local inspection cache, same-artifact render reuse, compact CLI replies, content review before final rendering, and tests scoped to the actual skill change. Acceptance and model policies remain mandatory.

New batches prefer cli_pool.py: bounded actual CLI workers, durable launch intent, independent process/session evidence, completion-first recovery and immediate refill. Old frozen batches do not gain CLI authorization automatically. Never relax sandbox, global configuration, model/effort or acceptance requirements.

Independent stage-local preparation/collection lanes and a single publication lane keep slow I/O outside the shared queue lock. Accepted work never blocks other stage reservations; validate exact case context and merge only its changes. Publish new accepted files before terminal history audit; close only after that audit succeeds.

Use controller-bound review_coverage to retain genuine passed, unaffected scopes. Independently inspect changed, dependent, new, failed or unreviewed content; reuse only previously reviewed identical current-render pages. Keep all six checks, current-document evidence and separate revision/review sessions. Frozen old batches are unchanged.
Biochemical fork: all six keys, pools, CLI evidence and verified_scope reuse retained. New batches use source_case_files; old frozen flat delivery batches retain their original policy and tools.
